    View Available Conversion Factors

    view_conversion_factors.Rd

    Displays the internal database of biomass conversion factors compiled from literature sources. Can filter by conversion type, taxonomic group pattern, or both.

    view_conversion_factors(
  conversion = NULL,
  group_pattern = NULL,
  show_sources = TRUE
)

    Arguments

    conversion

    Character. Type of conversion to display. If NULL, shows all available conversions for matching groups. Options:

    • "WM_to_DM" - Wet mass to dry mass

    • "DM_to_AFDM" - Dry mass to ash-free dry mass

    • "WM_to_AFDM" - Wet mass to ash-free dry mass

    • "DM_to_Energy" - Dry mass to energy (J/mg DM)

    • "AFDM_to_Energy" - AFDM to energy (J/mg AFDM)

    • "Water_percent" - Water content as percentage

    • "Ash_percent" - Ash content as percentage

    • "AFDW_percent" - Ash-free dry weight as percentage

    • "Carbon_percent" - Organic carbon as percentage

    • "WM_to_KCal" - Wet mass to KCal (inland waters)

    group_pattern

    Character. Regular expression pattern to filter taxonomic groups. Case-insensitive. If NULL, shows all groups (default = NULL).

    show_sources

    Logical. If TRUE, includes literature source column in output (default = TRUE).

    Value

    Invisibly returns a data frame with the displayed conversion factors.

    Details

    This function provides an interface to explore the internal conversion factors database used by ConvertBiomass. The database includes factors for over 80 taxonomic groups of marine and freshwater benthic organisms.

    Search Examples:

    • view_conversion_factors() - Show all groups and conversions

    • view_conversion_factors(conversion = "WM_to_DM") - Only WM→DM factors

    • view_conversion_factors(group_pattern = "Polych") - Groups containing "Polych"

    • view_conversion_factors(conversion = "AFDM_to_Energy", group_pattern = "acea") - AFDM energy for crustaceans

    Note: Energy conversions use column names J_per_mgDM and J_per_mgAFDM internally but can be requested as "DM_to_Energy" and "AFDM_to_Energy" for clarity.

    See also

    ConvertBiomass for applying conversion factors to data.

    Examples

    if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# View all available factors
view_conversion_factors()

# View only wet mass to dry mass conversions
view_conversion_factors(conversion = "WM_to_DM")

# Search for all Crustacea groups
view_conversion_factors(group_pattern = "acea")

# Search for Polychaeta energy conversions
view_conversion_factors(conversion = "AFDM_to_Energy", group_pattern = "Polych")

# Hide source column for cleaner output
view_conversion_factors(conversion = "WM_to_DM", show_sources = FALSE)
} # }
